name: Email/password, device enrollment and sealed session reload
procedure: Sign in as QA A; enroll a device; reload and restart; verify no plaintext tokens and correct account.

name: Google/Discord login and provider linking
procedure: Sign in with each advertised provider in the system browser; verify receipt proof, cancellation, linking and unlinking.

name: Recovery, MFA, passkeys, email change and devices
procedure: Verify recovery and MFA with owner-provided codes; inspect sessions; perform reversible QA-only device actions.

name: Profiles, free customization, styles and profile photos
procedure: Edit QA profile; verify free options persist after restart and are visible to QA B on another client.

name: Decorations, inventory and collectible submissions
procedure: Inspect inventory and select an owned free item; submit only an approved private test item; do not buy.

name: Encrypted direct message send, receive and reload
procedure: QA A sends a unique marker to QA B; verify both directions, reload persistence and wrong-key rejection.

name: History, replies, edits, deletes, pins and receipts
procedure: Exercise actions on QA-owned messages only; compare receipts/history on the second client.

name: Poll voting, forums, threads and results
procedure: Create a private QA poll/thread; vote as B and verify results and permissions across clients.

name: Emoji, GIFs, stickers and expressions
procedure: Send a small approved expression to private QA chat; verify picker, rendering and resource release.

name: Attachments, uploads, downloads and gallery
procedure: Send identifiable small files via backend authorization; compare SHA-256 after decryption; verify access denial, cancel/retry and cleanup.

name: Voice/video calls, devices, permissions and reconnection
procedure: A calls B; verify bidirectional audio/video, absent and disconnected devices, switching, network reconnection and sleep/wake.

name: Explicit screen/window sharing and capture release
procedure: Share a selected test window; compare receiver output; stop capture and verify tracks end, including disconnect and hangup.

name: Native notifications, pause and activity
procedure: With QA B in background receive one controlled DM; verify preview privacy, focus, pause and permission denial.

name: Friends, requests, group membership and blocking
procedure: Exchange a QA-only request; create an agreed private group; verify scoped visibility and reversible QA blocking.

name: Message search, saved items and discovery
procedure: Search the unique QA marker; verify saved items and filters; inspect public discovery without publishing.

name: Private community create, navigation, leave and ownership
procedure: Use owner-created private QA community; verify navigation and reversible edits. Deletion and ownership transfer require isolated tests.

name: Channels, categories, options and access
procedure: Create only approved QA channels; verify private visibility, read/write controls and navigation as A/B/C.

name: Roles, permissions and permission preview
procedure: Assign scoped QA moderator role to C; compare permission preview with real member access; no global role changes.

name: Community safety, reports, audit and rules
procedure: Inspect QA audit and safety screens; report QA-owned test content if authorized. Destructive moderation remains isolated.

name: Invitations, community guides, templates and onboarding
procedure: Open a private invite on desktop and second client; verify rule agreement, guide and role-limited onboarding.

name: Community lobby, voice rooms, meetings and events
procedure: Create a private QA event/room if authorized; join as A/B; verify updates, permissions and cleanup.

name: Bots, integrations and diagnostics
procedure: Inspect configured QA bot; issue scoped harmless command; verify diagnostics without enabling external public actions.

name: Channel webhooks, reaction roles and tickets
procedure: Use a private QA channel; verify access controls and ticket/reaction workflows. External webhook creation needs scoped authorization.

name: Plans, subscriptions, entitlements and checkout
procedure: Read QA entitlements in production. Execute purchases, cancellation and webhook transitions only on isolated sandbox backend.

name: Gifts, Spark, points, quests and rewards
procedure: Inspect balances and quests without reward/financial mutations; test gifts and transactions only in isolated sandbox.

name: Leaderboards, creators and verification
procedure: Read current pages and QA visibility; do not change public rankings or submit real verification applications.

name: Developer apps, OAuth consent and tooling
procedure: Inspect own QA application/consent; exercise scopes with isolated credentials; never expose app secrets in reports.

name: Appearance, privacy, localization, shortcuts and accessibility
procedure: Change reversible QA/local preferences; verify keyboard/focus, reduced motion, language and 720p layout.

name: Service health and operator-only screens
procedure: Inspect member-visible health. Operator-only functionality is not applicable to ordinary QA accounts; never promote them to test it.

name: App shell, routing, dialogs, common helpers and native integration
procedure: Verify local offline shell, native settings, IPC boundaries, safe links, cache preservation, economy mode and invite routing.

name: Local message translation and consent
procedure: Use a QA marker message; inspect first-use disclosure; translate locally if supported and verify stored encrypted text is unchanged. Unsupported native translation requires graceful fallback.

name: Discord community import
procedure: Inspect connection and permission UI; execute imports only on an isolated backend with an owner-approved source fixture. Never import external production data during controlled production QA.
